content.text: {"deal_state_line":"Ready to advance: dated 45 min session with COO Elena Varga set for 2026-10-08 14:00 CT, evaluators report no blockers, one technical item (partner hierarchy policy) open.","customer_value_line":"Dana's outcome: catch a late load while dispatch can still reroute it, not the next morning; in the 11 day sample the model flagged 214 loads that later missed their window, median flag about two hours before the window closed, and the 1:12 example was flagged versus 18 hours later by overnight batch.","what_we_validated":["Ingest: replay at 40,000 per second for twenty minutes (peak is about 38,000 per second), lag under four seconds at p95, queues rather than drops, default lag alert sixty seconds","dbt core, about three hundred models run as is: 298 ran in eleven minutes versus around forty today; two failed on a custom macro making an external API call at compile","Late load model on streaming data flagged one load at 1:12 into the run; overnight batch flagged it eighteen hours later","Warehouse connector continuous sync, about a minute end to end, default for new connections (RC-12)","Failed models show in run log with name and compile error; downstream models marked skipped, not silently stale"],"integration_patterns":["Telematics events (about 4.7 billion a month) into Apex streaming, late load model on the stream, warehouse connector with continuous sync for dispatch dashboards","Existing dbt core project runs on Apex runner; the macro's external lookup moves to a seed table or pre-hook","Row level policies keyed on partner ID for carrier partner dashboards; sub carrier hierarchy not yet validated"],"objections_and_answers":["Grace: hourly sync might be tight.
